Highlights

Full description
Embark on our Atacama Oasis Tour with hotel pickup, setting the tone for a day immersed in natural wonders. Accompanied by our expert bilingual guide, our first stop is the extraordinary Cejar Lagoon. Known for its high salt concentration, the lagoon offers a unique floating experience, reminiscent of the Dead Sea.

Surrounded by a stunning desert landscape, the deep blue hues of the lagoon against the shimmering white salt shores create a visual masterpiece. As the day progresses, watch the colors shift, casting warm, golden tones at sunset, transforming the landscape into a serene spectacle.

Continue the adventure to Ojos del Salar, natural freshwater springs amidst the vast salt flats. Marvel at this oasis-like phenomenon, offering a refreshing contrast to the surrounding arid terrain. Take a moment to soak up the unique atmosphere and capture the essence of this hidden gem.

Next, venture to the captivating Laguna Tebenquiche. Its salt shores create a unique sensory experience, inviting you to walk and connect with the silent, vast environment of the Atacama Desert. The landscape, reflected in the lagoon's waters, offers an ideal natural setting for contemplation and photography.

To conclude the experience, enjoy a cocktail in a unique natural environment, surrounded by the open landscapes of the Atacama Desert. A moment of pause and relaxation before your return, perfect for processing the experience.
